title: Bali BNB Mayhem
style: Comedy phonk with Aussie family singalong energy, bouncy half-time groove, beatboxed percussion, mouth-harmonica riffs, group-shouted hooks, playful call-and-response ad-libs, and a bright dusty mix that feels sun-baked, cheeky, and chaotic, bounce, oi, happy, comedy
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey’s on the deck
Dunedin brain, calm and quick
Mishy Mish Mash, pickleball queen
“Mate, pass me the win” and she grins

Ruby roo roo paints the wall
“My art stays with me,” says the little star
Wez goes, “¡Hola, bro!”
Gamer pro coach, too slick, too far

Black puppy Ashley’s on patrol
Mini sniffer poodle, nose to the floor
Aussie dog barks, “Where’s Michelle?”
“Off she goes” and she’s out the door

[Pre-Chorus]
Mate, what 2am?
Tree feel true and tall
And? crushed your car
Sweet new car, nah mate, insured, yeah

No computer says no
Fire burnt the caravan park out?
Sorry luv, we don’t cover that
No new park or car for you

[Chorus]
Bali is here!
Bali is here!
Plait your hair, mate
Bali is here!

Aussie Aussie Aussie
Oi oi oi, ha ha ha
Bali BNB
Never ending holiday!

[Verse 2]
Corey codes the super smart
Reversing forward, upside down
Mrs Squiggle at the laptop
“Watch this, I’ll spin it round”

What’s da pelican reckon?
A rotto quokka in the lounge
Ruby roo roo roo kanga bounce
Pink and grey galah around

Wezza, bo bo, aye i i
Spanish licks and cheeky chat
Mishy calls the pickle shot
“Too short, mate, too much fat”

Ashley, ash coloured shitzu
Then that mini black sniffer poodle
Two dogs with lots of frogs
Now the yard looks pure noodle

[Pre-Chorus]
Mate, what 2am?
The tiles all still and cold
Where’s our animals?
The sounds of Austlira are gone

Bali is here!
The house goes loud again
Plait your hair, mate
And let the chaos in

[Chorus]
Bali is here!
Bali is here!
Plait your hair, mate
Bali is here!

Aussie Aussie Aussie
Oi oi oi, ha ha ha
Bali BNB
Never ending holiday!

[Bridge]
Where’s Michelle?
Off she goes
Finds Michelle in a flash
Where’s our animals?
“Here we are!” through the splash

Bo bo bo
Aha here
Micha, Wezza
Ruby, Corey near

The family laughs
The dogs all spin
Bali BNB
Let the good day win

[Final Chorus]
Bali is here!
Bali is here!
Plait your hair, mate
Bali is here!

Aussie Aussie Aussie
Oi oi oi, ha ha ha
Bali BNB
Never ending holiday!

Bali is here!
Bali is here!
My art stays with me
Bali is here!
